title: ESM information transfer flag information element

fields.name: ESM information transfer flag IEI
fields.description: Information Element Identifier for ESM information transfer flag

fields.name: EIT value
fields.description: ESM information transfer bit: 0 = security protected ESM information transfer not required, 1 = security protected ESM information transfer required

notes: The ESM information transfer flag is a type 1 information element
Bits 4, 3, 2 are spare and set to 0
Bit 1 indicates whether security protected ESM information transfer is required
